Source: The Bamenda, Santa and Tiko Health Districts are in the highest malaria transmission strata of Cameroon.

Source: The purpose of this study was to explore the indicators of ownership and utilisation as well as maintenance of long-lasting insecticidal nets (LLINs) in three health districts in Cameroon.
Luganda: Omugaso gw’okunoonyereza kuno kwali kuzuula obubonero obwoleka obwannannyini, okukozesa awamu n’okulabirira obutimba bw’ensiri obuwangaazi obulimi eddagala eritta ebiwuka (LLINs) mu disitulikiti ssatu ez’omu ggwanga lya Cameroon.
Yoruba: Ìdí pàtàk̀ì fún ìwádìí yìí ni láti ṣàwárí àwọn atọ́ka tó ń fi níní àti ìṣàmúlò àti ní àfikún ìtọ́jú àwọn àwọ̀n apa-kòkòrò ọlọ́jọ́-pípẹ́ (àwọn LLIN) ní àwọn agbègbè ìlera mẹ́ta ní Cameroon.
Zulu: Inhloso yalolu cwaningo bekuwukuhlola izinkomba zobunikazi nokusetshenziswa kanye nokugcinwa kwamanethi ahlala isikhathi eside ezinambuzane (LLINs) ezifundeni ezintathu zezempilo eCameroon.
Hausa: Manufar wannan binciken ita ce bincika alamomin mallaka da amfani da kuma kula da gidajen sauro masu maganin ƙwari (LLINs) masu ƙarko a gundumomin kiwon lafiya uku a ƙasar Kamaru.
Northern Sotho: Maikemišetšo a dinyakišišo tše e bile go lekola dilaetši tša go ba beng le tša go šomiša gammogo le go hlokomela dinnete tša go bolaya dikhunkhwane tše di tšeago lebaka le letelele (di-LLIN) ka dileteng tša maphelo tše tharo ka Cameroon.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ዓላማ በካሜሩን በሶስት የጤና ወረዳዎች ውስጥ የረጅም-ዕድሜ ጸረ-ተባይ አጎበሮች (ረ.ዕ.ጸ.አ) ባለቤትነት እና አጠቃቀም እንዲሁም ጥገና አመልካቾችን ማሰስ ነበር።

Source: A cross-sectional household survey involving 1,251 households was conducted in the Bamenda, Santa and Tiko Health Districts in Cameroon.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okw’amaka okw’ekiseera ekimpi okulimu amaka 1,251 kwakolebwa mu disitulikiti za Bamenda, Santa ne Tiko mu ggwanga lya Cameroon.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí alákíyèsí ní àsìkò pàtó nípa àwọn ìdílé 1,251 jẹ́ ṣíṣe ní àwọn Agbègbè Ìlera Bamenda, Santa àti Tiko ní Cameroon.
Zulu: Inhlolovo yemizi ehlukene ehlanganisa amakhaya ayi-1,251 yenziwa ezifundeni zezempilo zase-Bamenda, e-Santa nase-Tiko e-Cameroon.
Hausa: An gudanar da wani bincike na gida da ya ƙunshi gidaje guda 1,251 a Gudumomin Lafiya na Bamenda da Santa da kuma Tiko a ƙasar Kamaru.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tša makala a mantši tša ka malapeng tšeo di akaretšago bakgathatema ba 1,251 di dirilwe ka Dileteng tša Maphelo tša Bamenda, Santa le Tiko ka Cameroon.
Amharic: በካሜሩን በባሜንዳ፣ በሳንታ እና በቲኮ የጤና ወረዳዎች 1,251 ቤቶችን ያሳተፈ ሰፊ የቤት ለቤት የዳሰሳ ጥናት ተካሂዷል።

Source: A structured questionnaire was used to collect data on LLINs ownership, utilisation, and maintenance as well as demographic characteristics.
Luganda: Questionnaire yakozesebwa okukuŋŋaanya obubaka obukwata ku bwannannyini, okukozesa n’okulabirira LLINs awamu n’enkalira z’abantu.
Yoruba: Ìwé-ìbèèrè kan tó léto ní wọ́n fi gba dátà lórí níní, ìṣàmúlò àti ìtọ́jú àwọn LLIN àti àwọn àbùdá tó jẹmọ́ èèyàn pàtó.
Zulu: Uhlu lwemibuzo oluhlelekile lwasetshenziswa ukuqoqa ingcobelelo ngobunikazi be-LLIN, ukusetshenziswa, nokugcinwa kanye nezici zezibalo zabantu.
Hausa: An yi amfani da ƙayyadaddun tambayoyi don tattara bayanai a kan mallakar LLINs, amfani da kiyayewa da kuma halayen alƙaluma.
Northern Sotho: Dipotšišonyakišišo tše di beakantšwego di šomišitšwe go kgoboketša tshedimošo ka ga go ba beng ba di-LLIN, go di šomiša, le go di hlokomela gammogo le dpharologantši tša sebopego sa dipalopalo ka ga batho.
Amharic: ስለ ረ.ዕ.ጸ.አ ባለቤትነት፣ አጠቃቀም እና ጥገና የስነ-ህዝብ አወቃቀር ባህሪያት መረጃን ለመሰብሰብ አንድ የተዋቀረ መጠይቅ ጥቅም ላይ ውሏል።

Source: The average number of LLINs per household was higher in the Bamenda Health District (BHD) compared to the Tiko Health District (THD) (2.5±1.4 vs 2.4±1.6) as well as the household ownership of at least one LLIN (93.3% vs. 88.9%).
Luganda: Omukkati gwa LLINs mu buli maka gwali waggulu mu disitulikiti ya Bamenda (BHD) bw’ogeraageranya ne disitulikiti ya Tiko (THD) (2.5±1.4 vs 2.4±1.6) awamu n’okubeera n’akatimba mu maka kwa waakiri LLIN kamu (93.3% vs. 88.9%).
Yoruba: Iye àpapọ̀ fún àwọn LLIN ní ìdílé kọ̀ọ̀kan ga ní Agbègbè Ìlera Bamenda (BHD) ju ti Agbègbè Ìlera Tiko (THD) lọ (2.5±1.4 sí 2.4±1.6) àti níní ó kéré jù, LLIN kan ní ìdílé kan (93.3% sí 88.9%).
Zulu: Isilinganiso senani lama-LLIN umuzi ngamunye laliphezulu eSifundeni Sezempilo Sase-Bamenda (BHD) uma kuqhathaniswa neSifunda Sezempilo sase-Tiko (THD) (2.5±1.4 vs 2.4±1.6) kanye nobunikazi bomuzi okungenani be-LLIN eyodwa (93.3% uma iqhathaniswa nama-88.9%).
Hausa: Matsakaicin adadin LLINs na kowane gida ya fi girma a gundumar Kiwon Lafiya ta Bamenda (BHD) idan aka kwatanta da gundumar Kiwon Lafiya ta Tiko (THD) (2.5± 1.4 vs 2.4± 1.6) da kuma mallakar gida na aƙalla LLIN guda ɗaya (93.3% vs.88.9%).
Northern Sotho: Palogare ga di-LLIN ka lapa e bile godimo ka Seleteng sa Maphelo sa Bamenda (BHD) ge se bapetšwa le Selete sa Maphelo sa Tiko (THD) (2.5±1.4 vs 2.4±1.6) gammogo le go ba beng ba malapa go bonyane LLIN e tee (93.3% vs. 88.9%).
Amharic: በባሜንዳ የጤና ወረዳ (ባ.ጤ.ወ) ከቲኮ የጤና ወረዳ (ቲ.ጤ.ወ) ጋር ሲነጻጸር በአንድ ቤተሰብ ውስጥ ያለው አማካይ የረ.ዕ.ጸ.አ ቁጥር (2.5±1.4 እና 2.4±1.6) እንዲሁም በቤተሰብ ውስጥ ቢያንስ የአንድ ረ.ዕ.ጸ.አ ባለቤትነት (93.3% እና 88.9%) ከፍ ያለ ነበር።

Source: The proportion of the de facto population with universal utilisation was higher in BHD compared to THD (13.1% vs 0.2%).
Luganda: Obungi bw’abantu abakozeseza ddala obutimba bw’ensiri bwali wagguluko mu BHD bw’ogeraageranya ne THD (13.1% vs 0.2%).
Yoruba: Ìpín fún ipò pàtó àwọn olùgbé pèlú ìṣàmúlò àgbáyé ga ní BHD lọ ju ti THD (13.1% sí 0.2%).
Zulu: Ingxenye yenani labantu noma kungengemtheho ngokuqinisekileyo elisebenzisayo emhlabeni wonke laliphezulu ku-BHD uma kuqhathaniswa ne-THD (13.1% vs 0.2%).
Hausa: Adadin yawan jama'a wanzajje tare da amfani na duniya ya fi girma a BHD idan aka kwatanta da THD (13.1% vs 0.2%).
Northern Sotho: Karolo ya setšhaba sa tokelo seo se bego se di šomiša ka kakaretšo e bile ye kgolo ka go BHD ge go bapetšwa le THD (13.1% vs 0.2%).
Amharic: ባ.ጤ.ወ ከቲ.ጤ.ወ ጋር ሲነጻጸር (13.1% እና 0.2%) ሁለንተናዊ አጠቃቀም ያለው ተጨባጭ የህዝብ ብዛት ውድሩ ከፍ ያለ ነበር።

Source: In multinomial regression analysis, households in the Santa Health District (SHD) (OR = 0.4, 95% = C.I; 0.2 – 0.8, p = 6.10×10−3), were less likely to own at least one LLIN, while those in the BHD (OR = 1.3, 95% = C.I; 0.8 – 2.1, p = 0.33) were more likely to maintain LLINs compared to those in THD.
Luganda: Mu nkola y’ebibalo ey’ebireetezi ebingi, amaka mu disitulikiti ya Santa (SHD) (OR = 0.4, 95% = C.I; 0.2 – 0.8, p = 6.10×10−3), gaalina emikisa mitono okubeera ne LLIN waakiri kamu, ate ago mu BHD (OR = 1.3, 95% = C.I; 0.8 – 2.1, p = 0.33) gaalina emikisa mingi egikuuma LLINs bw’ogeraageranya n’ago mu THD.
Yoruba: Nínú ìtúpalẹ̀ mọtinómíà rigẹ́ṣọ́ọ̀nù, àwọn ìdílé ní Agbègbè Ìlera Santa (SHD) (OR = 0.4, 95% = C.I; 0.2 – 0.8, p = 6.10×10−3), ni yóó le fún láti ní ó kéré jù LLIN, tí àwọn tó wà ní BHD (OR = 1.3, 95% = C.I; 0.8 – 2.1, p = 0.33) ni yóó rọrùn fún láti ṣètọ́jú àwọn LLIN tí a bá ṣe ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú àwọn tó wà ní THD.
Zulu: Ekuhlaziyweni kokuhlehla komnotho okuxubile, imindeni esesiFundazweni sase-Santa Health (SHD) (OR = 0.4, 95% = C.I; 0.2 – 0.8, p = 6.10×10−3), mancane amathuba okuthi okungenani ibe ne-LLIN eyodwa, kuyilapho leyo eku i-BHD (NOMA = 1.3, 95% = C.I; 0.8 – 2.1, p = 0.33) kwakungenzeka kakhulu ukuthi igcine ama-LLIN uma kuqhathaniswa nalawo aku-THD.
Hausa: A cikin nazarin koma baya da yawa, gidaje a cikin Gundumar Lafiya ta Santa (SHD) (OR = 0.4, 95% = C.I; 0.2 - 0.8, p = 6.10 × 10−3), ba su da yiwuwar mallakar aƙalla LLIN guda ɗaya, yayin da waɗanda suke cikin BHD (OR = 1.3, 95% = C.I; 0.8 - 2.1, p = 0.33) sun fi iya kula da LLINs idan aka kwatanta da waɗanda suke cikin THD.
Northern Sotho: Ka go tshekatsheko ya poelomorago ya dipalontši, malapa ka Seleteng sa Maphelo sa Santa (SHD) (OR = 0.4, 95% = C.I; 0.2 – 0.8, p = 6.10×10−3), go be go na le kgonagalo ye nnyane ya gore ba ka ba le LLIN e tee, mola e le gore ao a lego ka BHD (OR = 1.3, 95% = C.I; 0.8 – 2.1, p = 0.33) go be go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore a ka hlokomela di-LLIN go feta a ka THD.
Amharic: በመልቲኖሚናል አማካይ ተዛምዶ ትንተና ውስጥ በሳንታ የጤና ወረዳ (ሳ.ጤ.ወ) ያሉ ቤቶች (አ.ይ = 0.4, 95% = አ.ክ፤ 0.2 – 0.8፣ p = 6.10×10−3) ቢያንስ አንድ ረ.ዕ.ጸ.አ የመያዝ እድላቸው አነስተኛ ነበር፣ በ ባ.ጤ.ማ ውስጥ ያሉት ደግሞ (አ.ይ = 1.3፣ 95% = አ.ክ፤ 0.8 – 2.1፣ p = 0.33) ከቲ.ጤ.ወ ጋር ሲወዳደሩ ረ.ዕ.ጸ.አቸውን ይዘው የመቆየት አዝማሚያቸው ከፍተኛ ነበር፡፡

Source: Ownership of LLINs was low in SHD and THD in comparison to the goal of one LLIN for every two household members.
Luganda: Okubeera ne LLINs kwali wansi mu SHD ne THD bw’ogeraageranya n’ekiruubirirwa ekya LLIN kamu eri buli bantu babiri mu maka.
Yoruba: Níní àwọn LLIN kéré ní SHD àti THD ní ìfiwéra sí góòlù LLIN kan fún gbogbo èèyàn méjì-méjì ní ìdíle kọ̀ọ̀kan.

Amharic: ለየሁለቱ የቤተሰብ አባላት አንድ ረ.ዕ.ጸ.አ ተብሎ ከታለመው ግብ ጋር ሲነጻጸር የረ.ዕ.ጸ.አ ባለቤትነት በሳ.ጤ.ወ እና በቲ.ጤ.ወ ዝቅ ያለ ነበር።

Source: Overall, LLINs coverage and accessibility was still low after the free Mass Distribution Campaigns, making it difficult for all household members to effectively use LLINs.
Luganda: Okutwaliza awamu, okusaasaana kwa LLINs awamu n’obusobozi bw’okubufuna byali bikyali wansi oluvannyuma lw’enteekateeka z’okubugabira abantu ku bwereere, ne kikifuula kizibu okuba ng’abantu bonna mu maka bakozesa bulungi LLINs.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, agbègbè àwọn LLIN àti níní wọn lárọ̀wọ́tó ṣì kéré lẹ́yìn àwọn Ìpolongo Pípín ní ọ̀fẹ́ fún àwọn èèyàn, èyí tó jẹ́ kí ó le fún àwọn èèyàn nínú ìdílé lòó àwọn LLIN dáada.
Zulu: Sekukonke, ukutholakala kwe-LLIN nokufinyeleleka kwakusekuncane ngemva Kwemikhankaso yamahhala Yokusabalalisa Inqwaba, okwenza kube nzima kuwo wonke amalungu omndeni ukusebenzisa ngempumelelo ama-LLIN.
Hausa: Gabaɗaya, ɗaukar nauyin LLINs da samun damar har yanzu yana ƙasa bayan Gangamin Rarrabawa Jama'a kyauta, ya sa ya zama da wahala ga duk iyalan gida su yi amfani da LLINs yadda ya kamata.
Northern Sotho: Ka kakaretšo, kakaretšo ya di-LLIN le phihlelelo e be e sa le fase ka morago ga Masolo a Phatlalatšo a Magolo a go se lefelwe, gomme se sa dira gore go be boima go maloko a lapa ka moka go šomiša di-LLIN gabotse.
Amharic: በአጠቃላይ ከነፃ የጅምላ ስርጭት ዘመቻዎች በኋላ የረ.ዕ.ጸ.አ ሽፋን እና ተደራሽነት ዝቅተኛ ነበር፤ ይህም ለሁሉም የቤተሰብ አባላት ረ.ዕ.ጸ.አን በብቃት ለመጠቀም አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።
